# 📊 The Impact of Social Media on Student Behavior

An Agent-Based Modeling (ABM) project that simulates how study discipline, social media usage, academic foundation, and life balance pressure influence students' long-term productivity.

## Features

- Agent-Based Modeling (ABM) simulation
- Long-term productivity analysis
- Linear Regression for prediction
- Data visualization using Matplotlib

## Technologies

- Python
- NumPy
- Pandas
- Matplotlib
- Scikit-learn
- Jupyter Notebook

## Results

### Student Productivity Simulation

![Simulation Result](Images/simulation_result.png)

The simulation shows that students with higher study discipline and lower social media usage achieve significantly higher long-term productivity compared to students with lower discipline and higher digital distraction.

## Regression Performance

| Metric | Value |
|--------|------:|
| Mean Squared Error | 0.00217 |
| R² Score | 0.2919 |
